notes: The 'or' joins two different fields (RSI and distance from the 52-week low), and criteria are combined with AND. It is therefore a formula: RSI 14 under 30 OR within 5% of the 52-week low (pct_from_low_52w at or below 0.05).
Both sides are hard inside the formula, so there is no near-miss tolerance. RSI and the 52-week low distance are null for short histories, so those names only pass through the other side.
RSI under 30 or sitting at a 52-week low alone finds falling knives; a trend or turn check is offered as a suggestion.

formulas.name: draft_rsi_oversold_or_near_low
formulas.description: True when the 14-day RSI is under 30 or the close is within 5% of the 52-week low
formulas.null_meaning: Unknown when RSI or the 52-week low is unavailable (short history or a gap)

suggestions.why: Oversold or at the low in a downtrend keeps falling; a positive 20-day return is a turn signal
RSI under 30 is a bounce candidate only above the 200-day average

parts.words: RSI under 30 or within 5% of their 52-week low
parts.reading: RSI 14 under 30, or close within 0.05 of the 52-week low; either side passes
